episodes.title: Flushed
episodes.summary: Steve's long-running attempts to dump girlfriend Jane are constantly thwarted by his "accidental" tendency to keep having sex with her.

episodes.title: Size Matters
episodes.summary: Sally regrets turning down a date with Patrick after an eye-popping revelation from Susan.

episodes.title: Sex, Death & Nudity
episodes.summary: The attendance at the funeral of Jane's aunt snowballs as the friends arrange decoy dates.

episodes.title: Inferno
episodes.summary: Steve worries that Susan has discovered a compromising tape in his video library. Jane persuades her therapist to come along as a guest at a dinner party.

episodes.title: The Girl with Two Breasts
episodes.summary: Jeff has a tortuous time when he tries to chat up a beautiful foreign woman in the pub.

episodes.title: The Cupboard of Patrick's Love
episodes.summary: An alarming discovery is made by the girls about the contents of Patrick's cupboard.

episodes.title: The Man with Two Legs
episodes.summary: Sally has been seeing Liam for two weeks so now everyone wants to meet him. Jeff falls in love with a leg.

episodes.title: My Dinner in Hell
episodes.summary: Should you still be whistling if you've got a girlfriend?

episodes.title: Her Best Friend's Bottom
episodes.summary: Steve glimpses Sally's behind.

episodes.title: The Melty Man Cometh
episodes.summary: Following a disastrous impotent encounter with Sally, Patrick seeks reassurance from Steve and Jeff.

episodes.title: Jane and the Truth Snake
episodes.summary: Jane's career as a radio traffic reporter is put in jeopardy when she receives some unexpected criticism.

episodes.title: Gotcha
episodes.summary: It's one year since Steve and Susan's first date, and Steve is dreading questions about their future.

episodes.title: Dressed
episodes.summary: Jane meets a handsome stranger and ends up going to dinner with nothing to wear.

episodes.title: Naked
episodes.summary: Jeff's new boss Julia questions whether it is right and proper to kiss someone junior at work.

episodes.title: The End of the Line
episodes.summary: Susan and Steve each find themselves tempted by other people. Steve guiltily swaps phone numbers with an attractive woman in a bar.

episodes.title: Split
episodes.summary: Steve and Susan split up and make their separate ways to the Temple of Woman.

episodes.title: Faithless
episodes.summary: Jane finds herself in competition with the "supreme being of the universe".

episodes.title: Unconditional Sex
episodes.summary: Wilma offers Jeff 'no-strings' sex - after all, she only wants to 'borrow' him from his girlfriend, Julia.

episodes.title: Remember This
episodes.summary: Patrick and Sally have very different recollections of meeting at Susan's office party. Jeff expounds on 'porn jelly' and his names for breasts.

episodes.title: The Freckle, The Key and the Couple Who Weren't
episodes.summary: A quiet night in with Julia leads Jeff to a 'nudity hoovering' problem. Steve is troubled by a freckle on his bottom and reaches for the Book of Death - The Medical Health Encyclopedia. Sally and Patrick have become new-partner-hating best friends and possibly mole-buddies. And if all that wasn't enough, it's time for them all to meet James, Jane's religious broadcaster boyfriend who doesn't believe in sex before marriage.

episodes.title: The Girl with One Heart
episodes.summary: Sally is lonely, unhappy and unfulfilled. And then she goes and spoils it all.

episodes.title: Perhaps, Perhaps, Perhaps
episodes.summary: Sally finally admits how she really feels about Patrick.

episodes.title: 9 1/2 Minutes
episodes.summary: Susan is pregnant, Patrick and Sally are discussing relationships, and Jane has a blind date.

episodes.title: Nightlines
episodes.summary: Susan is worried she's turning into an emotional tent and Steve is being executed on a nightly basis - by a foetus.

episodes.title: Bed Time
episodes.summary: Can Patrick find his way home from the enchanted glade of his one true love and get a decent night's sleep?

episodes.title: Circus of the Epidurals
episodes.summary: At an antenatal class, Steve is haunted by the ghosts of spanking lesbians past, whilst Sally is troubled by a string quartet.

episodes.title: The Naked Living Room
episodes.summary: Is it possible that Oliver is getting somewhere with Jane? But how can you win the heart of a good woman when your living room has lost the battle with nudity?

episodes.title: 9 1/2 Months
episodes.summary: The night before the birth of his first child, Steve Taylor is visited by an old friend. Or possibly an old maths teacher.
